question: Can downmix configuration 4 be authored, and does it decode as well as configuration 3?
method: Two authored scenes, dee_ddpjoc_encoder online 768 kbps and --encoder bluray 1536 kbps. Ground truth by tools/ground_truth.py, objects against dlbac3dec out-ch-config=21 by tools/objcmp.py.
note: The onset scene's worst object is an element at -108 dBFS, 94.8 percent silent, in both modes; the others are 61 to 86 dB. Two silences do not make a measurement.
other_rates: 1152 and 1664 kbps also give configuration 4, clean, 15 objects, on the fixture scene.
